code:
# Deploy a throwaway Worker
npm create cloudflare@latest throwaway-worker
cd throwaway-worker && npx wrangler deploy

# Confirm it works
curl https://throwaway-worker.<your-subdomain>.workers.dev/

# Delete it
npx wrangler delete --name throwaway-worker

# Confirm deletion
curl https://throwaway-worker.<your-subdomain>.workers.dev/  # should fail
description: A starter hint that deploys a throwaway Worker, confirms it answers, deletes it, and confirms the URL no longer responds.

steps.description: This hint walks through a teardown drill on a throwaway Worker, so you do not delete your main one.
It scaffolds `throwaway-worker` and deploys it with `npx wrangler deploy`. The comment labels these the deploy steps.
`curl` checks the Worker's URL answers before you delete it. The comment says confirm it works.
`npx wrangler delete --name throwaway-worker` removes the deployed Worker.
The last `curl` checks the URL again. The comment says it should fail, which is how you confirm deletion.

title: Exercise 5: A Teardown Drill
